name: U-Line®  Seamless Collection 15" 2.8 Cu. Ft. Panel Ready Wine Refrigerator with Glass Door
shortDescription: For wine storage that complements any space, indoors or out, the Seamless 15" Wine Refrigerator is crafted for a truly integrated look, pairing an adjustable panel-ready grille for a continuous toe-kick with a panel-ready integrated door that can be finished with your own panel and hardware—or elevated with U-Line door wraps and a curated selection of pull styles and finishes. A black interior with warm black accents creates a cohesive design, and the 2.8 Cu. Ft. of capacity cradles up to 21 bottles on seven full-extension durable wire racks. Store your favorite varietals at their ideal temperatures with electronic touch controls that allow you to select a temperature from 34°F to 70°F, and set the mood with multi-point LED lighting in 30 color choices, including BrightShield® antimicrobial protection. Preserve your collection with premium refrigeration designed to provide the perfect pour every time. *CUSTOM PANEL & HANDLE SOLD SEPARATELY*

features.text: Adjustable panel-ready grille designed to seamlessly blend into cabinetry, allowing for a continuous toe-kick design
Black interior with warm black accents
Concealed, zero-clearance soft-close articulating door hinge
Panel-ready integrated door, customizable with your panel and hardware, or choose from the accessory options
Built for both indoor & outdoor use, with condensation mitigation system
Carbon filter for enhanced air quality and odor reduction
Center cabinet vertical lighting: Complete illumination for full visibility throughout the entire interior
Door alarm activates when the door is left open
Effortless entry door: Minimizes the physical effort needed, enhancing ease of use for all family members
Electronic touch control enables precise temperature selection from 34°F to 70°F
Evenly distributed forced-air refrigeration system delivers rapid cool down and temperature stability
Field reversible door is shipped right-hand hinged
Four leveling legs adjustable up to 1"
Low-E coated, argon gas filled, double thermopane glass door provides protection from harmful UV light
Low-profile variable speed compressor ensures efficient and powerful cooling with a max output of 1,850 BTU/h
Multi-point LED lighting with 30 color choices, including BrightShield® antimicrobial protection
Sabbath mode disables interior lights, alarms, and digital displays while maintaining consistent cooling performance
2.8 Cu. Ft. capacity stores up to 21 wine bottles
18-point side adjustability for unparalleled interior visibility
Seven full-extension, durable wire wine racks
